summary: Dalrada Technology Group filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly owned subsidiary Genefic, Inc. terminated financing agreements with IBS Equity Fund III and IBS Private Credit Fund IV, effective via notice delivered September 14, 2026. The package included a Master Performance Standby Letter of Credit and Guaranty Agreement with a stated commitment up to $20,000,000, a Master Credit, Security, and Account Purchase Agreement with a facility maximum of $5,000,000, a $181,500 Secured Promissory Note, a prefunded warrant, deposit account control, stock pledge, and collateral offset agreements. No funding, draws, or proceeds occurred; Item 2.04 flags acceleration/obligation triggers. Watch potential defaults, guarantor exposure, and disclosure of IBS remedies.
